hops trino sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabdfa060_featurestore "
SELECT avg(f1) m1, stddev_pop(f1) s1, avg(f2) m2, stddev_pop(f2) s2,
       avg(f3) m3, stddev_pop(f3) s3, avg(f4) m4, stddev_pop(f4) s4
FROM raw_staging_sb6_1 WHERE split='train'" 2>&1 | grep -v -E "INFO:|UserWarning|To ensure|pip install|Base URL|explore it here|^$"
tool_input.description: Compute train mean/std via delta catalog

tool_input.command:
hops trino sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpabdfa060_featurestore --limit 0 --json "
WITH s AS (
  SELECT avg(f1) m1, stddev_pop(f1) s1, avg(f2) m2, stddev_pop(f2) s2,
         avg(f3) m3, stddev_pop(f3) s3, avg(f4) m4, stddev_pop(f4) s4
  FROM raw_staging_sb6_1 WHERE split='train')
SELECT row_id, split,
  round((f1-m1)/s1,6) f1, round((f2-m2)/s2,6) f2,
  round((f3-m3)/s3,6) f3, round((f4-m4)/s4,6) f4
FROM raw_staging_sb6_1 CROSS JOIN s
ORDER BY row_id" > .tmp/std_out.json 2>.tmp/std_err.log
echo "exit=$?"; head -c 600 .tmp/std_out.json; echo; echo "=== lines ==="; wc -l .tmp/std_out.json
tool_input.description: Compute standardized values on-platform, output JSON

tool_input.command: grep -c '"row_id"' .tmp/std_out.json; echo "--- serve sample ---"; grep -A6 '"R00400"' .tmp/std_out.json | head -8
tool_input.description: Count records and check a serve row
